easyPrerequisites:
O'aka doesn't have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the additional creature
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing the flying counter from the additional creature, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat
